# Backlog & planning

A backlog that starts threads (with Jira and Notion), goals agents keep working on, schedules and a reorderable queue.

Pack id `planning`. Back to [all packs](README.md).

## Plugins

1. [`@dshfiles/backlog`](../../plugins/@dshfiles/backlog/README.md) — One capture feed for notes, tasks and agent work that organizes and ages itself.
2. [`@dshfiles/backlog-jira`](../../plugins/@dshfiles/backlog-jira/README.md) — Jira Cloud projects as a backlog sync provider: issues, workflow transitions, labels, priority, parents, issue links, due dates, ADF bodies and comments.
3. [`@dshfiles/backlog-notion`](../../plugins/@dshfiles/backlog-notion/README.md) — Notion data sources as a backlog sync provider: pages, status, tags, priority, parent, markdown bodies and comments.
4. [`@dshfiles/goal-tool`](../../plugins/@dshfiles/goal-tool/README.md) — Owned fork of DSH's goal tools that recognizes admitted answers to continued user-question forms
5. [`@dshfiles/schedule`](../../plugins/@dshfiles/schedule/README.md) — Owned native Tasks page and reminder catalogs that keep each catalog read until a schedule change or reconnect.
6. [`@dshfiles/queue-reorder`](../../plugins/@dshfiles/queue-reorder/README.md) — Drag-to-reorder the DSH message queue, using the durable inbox splice rather than remove-and-resend.

## Prerequisites

1. A project is added.

## Key settings

1. **Triage new backlog items automatically**: Settings entry `dshfiles-backlog`, field `autoTriage`.

## Features

From the onboarding feature catalog: 61 features, the 54 curated ones first.

### Curated

1. **Capture anything and let it sort itself** (`backlog`, work) — Type anything into one capture box, and its kind, title, tags and links are worked out for you.
2. **Configure Jev from the Backlog panel** (`backlog`, settings) — Set up Jev, automatic triage and its key from a tab in the Backlog panel or in Settings.
3. **Feed ordered by activity, with idle items sinking** (`backlog`, work) — The feed shows pinned items, then recent activity, and items left idle sink out of the way.
4. **Rename an item in place** (`backlog`, work) — Double-click an item's title to rename it in place, Enter to save and Escape to cancel.
5. **Board, links, backlinks and history** (`backlog`, work) — See items on a board by status, link them to threads, revisions and other items, and read their history.
6. **Customize Backlog board columns** (`backlog`, work) — Reorder or hide board columns in this browser without changing any item.
7. **Select items in ranges and batch-edit them** (`backlog`, work) — Select items with Shift and Cmd clicks, then edit or move them all at once.
8. **Apply every context-menu action to the selection** (`backlog`, work) — Right-click a selected item to apply an action to the whole selection.
9. **Triage new items automatically** (`backlog`, work) — Each new item can be sorted in the background, with its kind, title, tags and duplicates suggested.
10. **Backfill triage on items captured before it was set up** (`backlog`, work) — Triage older items in batches of 25 from the wand in the Backlog header.
11. **Mention backlog items with @** (`backlog`, composer) — Type @b: in the composer to mention a backlog item, or drag an item's label into a thread.
12. **See the backlog items that link to a thread or revision** (`backlog`, work) — A thread or revision lists the backlog items that link to it.

14. **Preview a referenced item from a conversation** (`backlog`, work) — Click a backlog item reference in a thread to preview the item without leaving.
15. **Search with reasons and saved views** (`backlog`, work) — Search items with filters, see why each result matched, and save the views you use.
16. **Items that need you** (`backlog`, inbox) — A filtered view of open items that need you, with triage suggestions and unread linked threads.
17. **A chat-sized capture box with files, properties and references** (`backlog`, work) — The capture box takes files, images, voice and references, with project, status and kind set before you send.
18. **Write descriptions and replies like a capture** (`backlog`, work) — Write descriptions and replies with mentions, Markdown, images and files, as in a capture.
19. **File and scope items by project** (`backlog`, work) — File items under a project and filter every view by one project or several.
20. **Hide items agents captured** (`backlog`, work) — Hide items an agent captured that you never touched, with a count of what is hidden.
21. **Start a thread from an item** (`backlog`, work) — Right-click an item to start a linked thread, copy its link or change its status, kind or project.

48. **Tasks and reminders load once** (`schedule`, work) — The Tasks page and thread reminders reload only when a schedule changes.
49. **Reorder pending messages** (`queue-reorder`, composer) — Move queued messages up, down or by drag.
50. **Edit queued messages in the composer** (`queue-reorder`, composer) — Edit a queued message in the composer, and it goes back to the same place in the queue.
51. **Preview queued message text** (`queue-reorder`, composer) — Each queued message shows a one-line preview of its text.
52. **Move a queued message to another thread** (`queue-reorder`, composer) — Move a queued message, with its files, to another thread.
53. **Preview queued attachments** (`queue-reorder`, composer) — Queued messages show a thumbnail for each image and a name for each file.

### More

1. **Move items from thread and revision signals** (`backlog`) — Items move on their own when a thread mentions them, a revision closes them or a turn gets stuck.
2. **Backlog work in the Activity timeline** (`backlog`) — Backlog changes show up in the activity feed alongside thread events.
3. **File a thread capture under its project** (`backlog`) — An item captured from a thread's workspace is filed under that workspace's project.
4. **Agents confirm bulk and destructive backlog writes** (`backlog`) — Agents must confirm before they revert, delete or change many items at once.
5. **Sync backlog items with a Jira Cloud project** (`backlog-jira`) — Sync backlog items with a Jira Cloud project, both ways, through a remote sync connection.
6. **Sync backlog items with a Notion data source** (`backlog-notion`) — Sync backlog items with a Notion database, both ways, through a remote sync connection.
7. **Answers to a timed question count as your request** (`goal-tool`) — An answer you gave to a timed question counts as your own request for a goal.

## Enable it

1. In the app: **Knowledge › Getting started**, then **Enable pack** on Backlog & planning under Packs. It previews exactly what changes; **Disable pack** reverses it.
2. From an Agent: the `onboarding_pack_apply` tool with pack `planning`. It runs only when you ask, after showing the preview.
3. From a shell: `dshx init --profile <name> --packs planning` (Core is added; `--dry-run` previews). See [`dshx init`](../../tooling/dshx/docs/cli-reference.md#dshx-init-compose-a-profile-from-packs).

## Restart

Installing a plugin the profile does not have yet needs a DSH Host restart: DSH reads the profile once at boot. Plugins already installed are switched on in the running DSH. Nothing restarts on its own: use **Restart when idle** in the sidebar when DSH runs under the managed launcher, otherwise your own launcher.
